description.value: Mountainview Brewing Co. is a family-friendly craft brewery and taproom in Hope, BC, brewing with fresh Fraser Valley mountain water and a mandate to be a welcoming, inclusive community gathering space. The rotating tap list spans everything from hoppy IPAs showcasing BC-grown hops to barrel-aged mixed-culture saisons aged on golden plums picked locally in Hope. Sitting at the junction of the Crowsnest Highway corridor and the Fraser Valley, it is a natural refuelling stop for cyclists on multi-day tours through the region.

address.value: 390 Old Hope-Princeton Way, Hope, BC V0X 1L4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website FAQ explicitly confirms bicycle parking ('right in front of our patio in the front parking lot, please bring your own lock'), confirming the bike parking criterion. The contact page corroborates the OSM address (390 Old Hope Princeton Way) and provides a phone number (+1 236 355 1333) absent from OSM tags. The OSM check_date of 2026-05-16 and active Shopify-powered website confirm the business is open; the FAQ also confirms pickup/takeout orders are available.
concerns: OSM name is 'Mountainview Brewing' but the website consistently uses 'Mountainview Brewing Co.' — minor name discrepancy worth correcting in OSM.
OSM tags contain no phone number; phone (+1 236 355 1333) sourced from website contact page only, so contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible craft brewery and taproom with confirmed bicycle parking, food, and a welcoming community-space mandate — a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists on the Hope corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Dogs welcome on the patio per FAQ. Growler fills available. Non-alcoholic menu exists (separate nav item). Beer also available via Canada Post shipping within BC.

Bike parking or bike visibility.detail: FAQ states: 'WE DO! YOU CAN FIND OUR BICYCLE PARKING RIGHT IN FRONT OF OUR PATIO IN THE FRONT PARKING LOT. PLEASE BRING YOUR OWN LOCK.'
